newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Aumar to cut share nominal, pay back cash.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Aumar to cut share nominal, pay back cash.

text.p: Spanish motorway toll firm Autopistas del Mare Nostrum (Aumar) is to propose a cut in its share nominal to 970 pesetas from 1,000 pesetas, returning the difference to shareholders, a spokesman said on Wednesday.
The move will be made effective in the year following the shareholders' meeting on June 25.
Aumar's move to make a one-off payment to shareholders was a reflection of the fact that the firm has a cash surplus.
"We were excessively capitalised in order to make investments, and once we've paid off debts and made provisions the logical thing is to return cash to shareholders," he said.
At 0825 GMT, Aumar shares were up 40 pesetas to 2,140.
